articles.title: Fortnite's Sprite Spree Week: Catch 'Em All Before the Season Ends!
articles.summary: Fortnite is boosting sprite spawns for a whole week starting Aug. 15! Galaxy, Holo, Cube, and Gem sprites will each get a day of increased odds. Plus, you'll get a Lucky Sprite Locator and double XP. Don't miss your chance to finish your collection!

articles.title: Swiatek Reaches First Final of Her 'Toughest Season'!
articles.summary: Iga Swiatek fought hard to beat Elina Svitolina and reach the Canadian Open final. She'll face Elena Rybakina, who also won a tough three-set match. It's Swiatek's first final in a year—and she says this season has been her toughest ever.

articles.title: Attack on Titan Is Coming Back?! WIT Studio Teases a New Project!
articles.summary: WIT Studio just teased a new Attack on Titan announcement coming Aug. 20! The cryptic post shows Eren, Armin, Mikasa, and others. Could it be a prequel? We'll find out next week!
